build_block_parser: build a default Markdown block parser with all registered block processors for parsing
create_custom_block_processor: create a custom BlockProcessor subclass that overrides test and run methods to handle new block types
process_code_blocks: process indented code blocks by creating pre and code elements in the ElementTree
process_list_blocks: process ordered and unordered list blocks by parsing list items into li elements
process_blockquotes: process blockquote blocks by stripping leading greater-than markers and recursively parsing content
